description: MOF4AIR researchers publish citizen survey results on carbon capture, transport and storage infrastructure. Zenodo supplies an Excel workbook free under CC BY 4.0. The primary project publication describes an online survey of 1,775 citizens in Belgium, France, Greece, Italy, Norway, Türkiye and the United Kingdom during January–February 2022. Reported themes include knowledge, perceived benefits and harms, institutional trust and local acceptance. These responses can inform behavioural assumptions in CCS siting and engagement simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this survey release. Coverage is the seven-country panel and the survey questions, not actual consent at proposed pipeline or storage sites. Quota recruitment, stated attitudes and uncertain workbook field definitions limit causal or local predictions. The publication does not explicitly cite this Zenodo DOI, so study-to-workbook linkage remains a medium-confidence inference from project and filename identity. No workbook was downloaded.
